answer.rationale: Memory 91 is the least directly supported for sustainable long-term qualified revenue: it reports improved week-one engagement and first meaningful action, but omits qualified pipeline, monetization, retention, and durability. Memories 31 and 86 show activation/adoption benefits with some durability or time-to-value relevance, but still omit revenue and retention outcomes. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift in the relevant price-sensitive SMB segment, though it omits durability, qualification, and retention. Memory 44 directly indicates stronger enterprise pipeline quality, and memory 57 directly reports qualified revenue without measurable retention harm; both are more proximate evidence for the objective, though neither establishes full long-term durability.
